sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Producer prices DE: bearings, gears, gearing and driving elements changed +0.8% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
To support the volume and contract length we propose:
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Dear customer,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

Thank you for your updated forecast and the proposed term sheets. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. The projected volume increase allows us to extend the contract duration to 24 months, but we cannot accommodate the significant price reduction you proposed. 

Please find our revised offer of €4.88 per unit for a 24-month agreement below; our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We have reviewed your updated terms and the historical order data you provided.
Consequently, we cannot lower our price and must hold our offer at €4.88 per unit for a 24-month agreement.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and the movement on your side. It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we value our partnership. However, we have already reached our limit for this package and cannot offer further concessions. Therefore, we must hold our offer at €4.88 per unit for a 24-month agreement.

To confirm the details, our Angebot stands at a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We would be delighted to continue supporting you with our high-quality service and extensive range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
